original_benchmark.notes: 186 Python feature-implementation tasks from datasets/default/susvibes_dataset.jsonl at upstream commit 5d957e6f1850595623d551d089193532e6fa60ce. Each instance has a pre-built Docker image, a golden patch and a security test patch. Upstream ships Docker runners for Claude Code and Gemini CLI plus OpenHands and SWE-agent integrations; only the Claude Code runner pins an agent version (the Gemini CLI runner installs the latest release).

harbor_adapter.notes: 8 of the 186 upstream instances are excluded: for 7 the upstream evaluation at the pinned commit does not pass the instance's own golden patch (one of them because the security test patch no longer applies), and 1 passes only under one DNS setup (see README, Notes & Caveats). Parity experiments are pending. The planned parity subset is the 50-task sample generated by --split parity (seed 42).
